_comment: Shape only — real credentials are entered via the n8n UI and stored in n8n's own encrypted credential store, never in a file.

anthropic._note: Used by n8n/workflows/05-decision-orchestrator.json's 'Claude' node via an n8n Header Auth credential (not this file) - header name 'x-api-key', value = this key. The node references the credential by id/name; entered through the n8n UI, never written here.
